hero.title: Free and Open-Source Software for your Cocktail Machine
hero.description: CocktailBerry is a powerful open-source platform for building custom cocktail machines on the Raspberry Pi or other SBCs. Leveraging Python, Qt, and React, it offers a flexible and scalable solution for creating unique automated bartending experiences. Whether you are building a single machine or deploying a fleet, CocktailBerry provides consistent software across all installations. Detailed information, installation steps and set up can be found in the documentation.

features.title: Main Features
features.subtitle: CocktailBerry comes packed with versatile features right out of the box. Explore some of the key benefits.

easySetup.title: Easy to Set-Up
easySetup.description: On a fresh Raspberry Pi, one command is all you need. The tool will make the rest for you. Lay back, grab a drink, and come back to a fully functional cocktail maker.

configuration.title: Configuration over the App
configuration.description: Once installed, just run the software and go to the settings. Here you can configure everything to your liking and the state of your machine.

customCocktails.title: Customize your Cocktails
customCocktails.description: You can manage change, add or delete all the cocktail data over the app. This includes ingredients and recipes, things to add via hand and pumping order.

multiLanguage.title: Multi Language Support
multiLanguage.description: The app is available in multiple languages. You can easily switch between them in the settings. If you want to, you can even provide translation for your language.

addOns.title: Custom Add-Ons
addOns.description: Missing some custom feature? Just add it! The software is designed to be easily extendable. You can add your own features and even share them with the community.

batteriesIncluded.title: Batteries Included
batteriesIncluded.description: Many additional nice things to have: Custom app themes, cleaning program, data visualization and export, LED + NFC support, option to send data to webhooks and more.

payment.title: Supports Payment Systems
payment.description: Use the SumUp integration or a self hosted service with NFC Chips to let your customers pay for their drinks. You can also restrict the NFC chips to non-alcoholic beverages.

servicePersonnel.title: Service Personnel Mode
servicePersonnel.description: With the service personnel mode, you can easily manage your machine in a bar or restaurant setting. This includes features access control and observability.

testimonials.title: What Our Users Say
testimonials.subtitle: CocktailBerry especially brings joy to people who just want to build, but not program. In case you want to program, add-ons also provide an easy way to extend the functionality.

thomas.name: Thomas
thomas.content: A few inputs and the code was running! I was totally amazed, especially by the extent of the software and the clean, well-designed interface.

adnan.name: Adnan
adnan.content: I've tried a few cocktail software programs, and I have to say, yours is the one that's the best structured.

marvin.name: Marvin
marvin.content: It's great to see how much effort you put in, and that it's not a project that gets abandoned after just one or two updates.

intro.title: Build Your Own Cocktail Machine
intro.subtitle: CocktailBerry runs on affordable, off-the-shelf parts. Here is an overview of the hardware you can use to build your own automated cocktail machine. You mix and match — there is no single required setup.

hardware.docsCallout: This page is a quick starting overview. For the complete, up-to-date parts list with every option and wiring details, see the
hardware.docsLink: full hardware list in the documentation

components.title: Core Components
components.subtitle: The essential building blocks. Pick the parts that fit your build and budget.

pi.title: Raspberry Pi
pi.description: The brain of your machine. A Raspberry Pi 3B+, 4, or 5 runs the CocktailBerry software. Any of them works — newer models are simply faster.

display.title: Touchscreen
display.description: Your guests order drinks on a touch display. A 5" or 7" screen is the common choice; the official Raspberry Pi touchscreen works too.

sdCard.title: SD Card
sdCard.description: A 16–32 GB micro SD card holds the Raspberry Pi operating system and CocktailBerry.

controller.title: Controller Board
controller.description: Switches your pumps on and off via the Raspberry Pi's GPIO pins. Use a relay board for simple on/off control, or a motor shield for finer control.

power.title: Power Supply
power.description: You need two separate circuits: one 5V supply for the Pi and a stronger supply for the pumps — the Pi alone cannot power them.

tubing.title: Food-Safe Tubing
tubing.description: Food-safe hose carries your ingredients from the bottles to the glass. Plan for roughly 5–10 m depending on your number of pumps.

wiring.title: Wiring & Cables
wiring.description: Female-to-female jumper wires connect the relay board to the Pi, plus the usual HDMI and USB cables.

payment.title: Payment (Optional)
payment.description: Add a USB RFID reader and NFC tags to let guests pay for their drinks — handy for bars, events, or charity setups.

pumps.title: Supported Pumps
pumps.subtitle: Pumps are the heart of the machine. CocktailBerry drives any standard DC- or stepper-based pump or motor, so the types below are just common examples — not the only options. Each pump is wired through the controller board and controlled by the software.
pumps.note: Whichever type you choose, make sure the pumps are food-safe and powered from a separate circuit — not from the Raspberry Pi.

membrane.title: Membrane Pumps
membrane.description: Self-priming diaphragm pumps that move liquid quickly and handle being mounted above the bottles well. A popular, affordable choice.

peristaltic.title: Peristaltic Pumps
peristaltic.description: Only the silicone tube touches your ingredients, which keeps things clean and easy to maintain. Gentle and precise, ideal for accurate pours.

extensions.title: Easy to Extend
extensions.description: Missing a feature or a special piece of hardware? CocktailBerry is built to be extended. With its add-on system you can program almost anything — custom LEDs, sensors, notifications, or your own logic — and even share it with the community.
